scope: Review of existing frozen 60 pairs only; not an upstream dataset-wide rejection.
criteria: Preserve source complexion/undertone and plausible texture outside intended cosmetics.
Preserve recognizable face, expression, lip boundary and teeth.
Show useful visible cosmetics without unrelated scene/clothing/hair edits.
Retain original source credit, license and identity-disjoint split.
method: Qualitative inspection of all 12 source-plus-five-target sheets; five less-clear pairs additionally checked at native 512 resolution. No numerical quality scores or independent salon approval.
